svg.title: omni2api
svg.text: Ring stroke 34 · cursor 62 × 31 · gap 15 on a 148 ring. The cursor sits on the
baseline; the ring overshoots it by 2, as every round letter should.
Drawn, not typeset: one 21-unit stroke, true circles, square i-dots
aligned to the top of the 2. Every glyph is arcs and straight lines.
Signal is reserved for the cursor. Never set the ring or the wordmark in it.
160 · 96 · 64 · 48 · 32 · 24 · 16 px — below 32 px use the pixel-snapped favicon cut
